name: No staleness warning on a match whose odds are fresh
description: The staleness badge must be conditional, not always-on. For a match whose oldest book is within the 6-hour freshness window (is_stale false), the Odds tab must NOT show the stale-odds warning. An always-present badge defeats its purpose.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and read match ids, then for each navigate to /match-odds/<id>.json and inspect staleness.is_stale and staleness.age_hours to find a match whose oldest book is 6 hours old or less (is_stale false)
Open that match's detail page and click the Betting Odds tab

Verify the Odds tab for this fresh match does NOT display a stale-odds warning badge. If the warning appears on a match the artifact marks is_stale false, the badge is unconditional and this test fails.
